title: FrontierMath: A Benchmark for Evaluating Advanced Mathematical Reasoning in AI
authors_zh: Elliot Glazer 等（Epoch AI、King's College London、MIT、University of Siegen 等）
paper_type_zh: arXiv preprint 的 benchmark / evaluation surface
best_for_zh: 研究高级数学评测、专家题库、自动 verifier、hidden/public split 与污染控制的读者。
one_line: FrontierMath tests frontier models on original expert-written advanced mathematics problems with controlled release and automated verification.
FrontierMath 用专家原创、低污染的高等数学题和自动验证来测试 frontier model 的真实数学推理边界。
why: It turns expert problem authorship, hidden/public access, and verifier coverage into central fields for evaluating whether hard math benchmarks are reusable feedback contracts.
inclusion_reason: FrontierMath is a high-priority expert-written, low-contamination advanced-math benchmark with an explicit automated-verification scoring contract and important access-policy risks.

title: Problem
问题
html: FrontierMath asks whether frontier AI systems can solve original expert-written advanced mathematics problems that are hard to contaminate and often require concise verifiable answers. The primary sources are arXiv:2411.04872 and the Epoch AI project page. It belongs here as a controlled-access advanced-math benchmark, not as a public training corpus or proof dataset. A problem includes a statement, domain/difficulty metadata, expected answer, and an answer-checking or verifier policy where available. Its atlas value is the explicit tension among expert authorship, hidden access, answer verification, and reproducibility.

FrontierMath 关注的问题是：frontier AI 系统能否解决由专家原创、低污染、通常有简洁可核验答案的高等数学问题。主要来源是 arXiv:2411.04872 和 Epoch AI 项目页。这里收录它是因为它是 controlled-access advanced-math benchmark，而不是公开训练语料或证明数据集。一个问题包含题面、领域/难度元数据、期望答案，以及可用的 answer-checking 或 verifier policy。它对 atlas 的价值是把专家原创、隐藏访问、答案验证和可复现性之间的张力显式化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a benchmark of hundreds of original expert-vetted advanced mathematics problems across major branches, intended to remain difficult for frontier models and reduce contamination. The mechanism is expert problem writing and review, controlled release, difficulty tiering, and answer-level verification/checking. The feedback contract is programmatic or rule-based answer acceptance where available, under access-controlled benchmark policy. Closest comparisons are MATH, OlympiadBench, GPQA-style expert benchmarks, and formal proof benchmarks. The direction label is high-difficulty hidden math evaluation with verifier coverage as an audit field.

核心贡献是数百道由专家原创和审核的高等数学问题，覆盖主要数学分支，目标是保持对 frontier models 的难度并降低污染。机制包括专家命题与评审、受控发布、难度分层和 answer-level verification/checking。反馈契约是在访问控制政策下，用程序化或规则化答案验收。最近对比是 MATH、OlympiadBench、GPQA 式专家 benchmark 和 formal proof benchmark。方向标签是把 verifier coverage 作为审计字段的高难隐藏数学评测。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Inputs: expert-authored math problems, expected answers, domain/tier metadata, and answer-checking rules. 2. Pipeline: write and review original problems, select for difficulty and novelty, keep controlled-access tiers, evaluate model answers against expected answers or verifiers, and report aggregate solve rates. 3. Outputs: benchmark tiers, model scores, selected public/open-problem material, and access-policy notes. 4. Feedback: an answer is accepted when the benchmark's checker or adjudication rule accepts it for that problem version. 5. Reuse requires pinning benchmark version, tier, access policy, verifier coverage, answer normalizers, and whether Open Problems are being mixed with Tiers 1-4.

1. 输入：专家命题、期望答案、领域/层级元数据和答案检查规则。2. 流程：原创命题并评审，按难度和新颖性筛选，保留受控访问层级，用期望答案或 verifier 评测模型回答，并报告汇总解题率。3. 输出：benchmark tiers、模型分数、部分公开/open-problem 材料和访问政策说明。4. 反馈：当 benchmark checker 或 adjudication rule 接受某版本问题的答案时才算成功。5. 复用前要固定 benchmark 版本、tier、访问政策、verifier coverage、answer normalizer，以及是否把 Open Problems 与 Tiers 1-4 混用。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that then-current frontier systems solved under 2% of the benchmark, supporting the claim that these expert problems were far beyond saturated math sets at release. The project page later reports FrontierMath v2, released on June 12, 2026, addressed errors in 42% of problems, which is crucial evidence about benchmark maintenance risk. Row-level evidence is the accepted answer or verifier result for a problem version, not the public problem statement alone. Scores are bounded by access policy, model tool use, answer normalization, and benchmark version.

论文报告当时 frontier systems 在 benchmark 上解出率低于 2%，支持其相对饱和数学集更难的说法。项目页后续报告 FrontierMath v2 于 2026-06-12 发布，并修正了 42% problems 的错误，这是 benchmark 维护风险的重要证据。逐样本证据是某版本问题的 accepted answer 或 verifier result，而不是公开题面本身。分数受访问政策、模型工具使用、答案归一化和 benchmark 版本约束。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior math benchmarks are often public, competition-derived, or easier to contaminate. FrontierMath changes the construction by commissioning original advanced problems and controlling access while aiming for answer verification. The direction signal is that hardest-math evaluation must record provenance, release policy, and verifier coverage together. What is not new is answer-level math scoring. Before reuse, inspect problem errors, version changes, hidden/public split, checker coverage, and whether tool-assisted solving is allowed.

已有数学 benchmark 往往公开、来自竞赛或更容易污染。FrontierMath 的变化是委托原创高等数学题并控制访问，同时追求答案验收。方向信号是：最高难数学评测必须同时记录 provenance、release policy 和 verifier coverage。answer-level 数学评分本身并不新。复用前要查题目错误、版本变化、hidden/public split、checker coverage，以及是否允许工具辅助解题。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Controlled access improves contamination resistance but limits independent reproducibility. Automated verification may cover only certain answer forms, and expert problems can still contain mistakes, as the v2 correction note illustrates. High difficulty can conflate mathematical reasoning, search, domain knowledge, formatting, and tool use. FrontierMath should not be treated as a reusable reward source unless the exact problem version, checker, and access terms are available.
受控访问提升抗污染，但限制独立复现。自动验证可能只覆盖某些答案形式，专家题也仍可能有错误，v2 修正说明正体现了这一点。高难度会混合数学推理、搜索、领域知识、格式和工具使用。除非能拿到精确问题版本、checker 和访问条款，否则不应把 FrontierMath 当作可复用 reward source。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use FrontierMath as an audit checklist for hard hidden benchmarks. Preserve problem id, version, domain, tier, statement, expected answer, verifier type, normalization rule, access status, release date, and correction history. It is useful for deciding whether a math benchmark is evaluating reasoning ability or merely enforcing a scarce hidden answer set.
可把 FrontierMath 用作高难隐藏 benchmark 的审计清单。复用时保留 problem id、version、domain、tier、题面、期望答案、verifier type、normalization rule、访问状态、发布日期和修订历史。它适合判断数学 benchmark 是在评估推理能力，还是主要依赖稀缺隐藏答案集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the access and version notes before the headline solve rate. Keep Tiers 1-4, Open Problems, public examples, and v2-corrected problems separate. The under-2% result is a release-time benchmark fact, not a timeless property of advanced math reasoning.
先读访问和版本说明，再看 headline solve rate。要分开 Tiers 1-4、Open Problems、公开样例和 v2 修正题。低于 2% 是发布时的 benchmark 事实，不是高等数学推理的永久属性。
